# getopt

Vendored copy of GNU getopt, used to provide `getopt` / `getopt_long`
on platforms that lack a POSIX implementation (notably MinGW).

## Upstream

- Source: https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/tree/master/libiberty
- Files taken:
  - `libiberty/getopt.c`
  - `libiberty/getopt1.c`
  - `include/getopt.h`
  - `include/ansidecl.h`
